@graph.name: Supplier Catalog Search for Promo Products | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Search supplier catalogs by vendor, SKU or keyword and start a mockup instantly. PromoPlus gives distributors product data and images without manual setup.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to download product images?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Product images and details come from the catalog, so you only upload your customer's artwork.

mainEntity.name: How can I search supplier products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Search integrated supplier catalogs by vendor name, SKU or product keyword.

mainEntity.name: Can I add a product that isn't in a catalog?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can add a product manually to a PromoPlus project when it is not in a supplier catalog.

mainEntity.name: Does the selected product carry into the rest of the workflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It moves straight into the Online Mockup Designer and stays attached to the project through approval and production.

@graph.name: Online Mockup Software for Promotional Products | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Place logos on promo products, preview every side and generate customer-ready mockups in your browser. No Illustrator needed for every proof.

mainEntity.name: Do I need Adobe Illustrator to make a mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You upload the logo, position and resize it on the product, and generate the proof in your browser.

mainEntity.name: What artwork files can I upload?

acceptedAnswer.text: PromoPlus currently accepts SVG artwork files for the mockup designer.

mainEntity.name: Can I preview every side of a product?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can place and preview artwork on each available side, such as front, back and sleeve.

mainEntity.name: Can I send the mockup straight to the customer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The finished proof moves into the Customer Approval Portal for review and sign-off.

@graph.name: Artwork Version Control and Proof History | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Every artwork revision is saved automatically. Compare versions, restore earlier artwork and always know which version the customer approved.

mainEntity.name: Are artwork revisions saved automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every change is saved and stays attached to the same product and project.

mainEntity.name: Can I compare versions or restore an earlier one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can compare revisions side by side and restore previous artwork.

mainEntity.name: How do I know which version the customer approved?

acceptedAnswer.text: The approved version is clearly marked and recorded in the project history, so there is no guessing between files like design_final_2.pdf.

mainEntity.name: Is the approved version locked?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The approved version is locked against further edits.

mainEntity.name: Does version history carry through to production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The approved version is the one used to generate the production file.

@graph.name: Customer Artwork Approval Portal | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Share a secure approval link. Customers review mockups, comment, request revisions and approve designs, and every decision is recorded.

mainEntity.name: How does a customer approve a mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You share a secure link. The customer reviews the mockup, leaves comments or requests a revision, and approves the design.

mainEntity.name: Does the customer need an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Anyone with the shared link and access code can view and approve the mockup without a PromoPlus account.

mainEntity.name: Are comments tied to the exact mockup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Feedback pins and decisions stay attached to the specific version being reviewed, not a separate email thread.

mainEntity.name: Is every approval recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The decision is stored with the version, date and time.

mainEntity.name: Does PromoPlus send email notifications for review activity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PromoPlus sends email notifications when a customer comments, requests a revision, or approves a mockup.

mainEntity.name: What happens after approval?

acceptedAnswer.text: PromoPlus can generate the production-ready PDF from the approved version.

@graph.name: Centralized Project Workspace for Promo Teams | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Keep products, artwork, customer details, approvals, notes and production files in one project record, from first product to final file.

mainEntity.name: What is stored in a project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Products, artwork, customer information, approvals, notes, production files and the full project history.

mainEntity.name: Can I see what happened on a project and when?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The project history lists each step in order, such as product added, artwork uploaded, version reviewed, customer approved and production file generated.

mainEntity.name: Does the product from the catalog stay attached to the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Supplier details, imagery, sides and color choices stay with the project for everyone working on it.

mainEntity.name: Can I stop searching emails and shared folders for project files?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is the purpose. Files, comments and decisions live in one record instead of across inboxes.

mainEntity.name: Is customer information stored in the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The project stores the customer's name and email address.

@graph.name: Team Collaboration for Promo Distributors | PromoPlus
@graph.description: Sales, design, operations and owners work in one shared project with the same artwork, approvals and status. Fewer handoffs, less rework.

mainEntity.name: Which roles can work in the same project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sales representatives, brand advisors, designers, operations teams and business owners.

mainEntity.name: Do all roles see the same information?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everyone works from the same project record, and each role can focus on the part its next decision depends on.

mainEntity.name: Can remote production partners work in the project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can add an outside production partner as an advisor to coordinate in the project.

mainEntity.name: How does this reduce rework?

acceptedAnswer.text: Comments and decisions sit beside the work they refer to, so teams stop rebuilding context across email and separate tools.

@graph.name: Artwork Workflow Dashboard for Promo Teams | PromoPlus
@graph.description: See every artwork project by stage: pending artwork, awaiting approval, revisions and production ready. Catch blocked work before deadlines slip.

mainEntity.name: What stages can I see on the dashboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pending artwork, awaiting approval, revision requests and production ready, with a count for each.

mainEntity.name: Can I filter projects by stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can filter the workflow by stage and focus on the projects that need a decision now.

mainEntity.name: How do I spot blocked work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Projects show their current status and reason, such as source file missing or client link opened, so a blocker is visible before it becomes a delay.

mainEntity.name: Who can see the dashboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Owners and team members can access the dashboard, but their views differ.

@graph.name: Production-Ready Artwork Files After Approval | PromoPlus
@graph.description: After customer approval, PromoPlus generates a production-ready PDF with approved artwork and placement details for decorators and suppliers.

mainEntity.name: When is the production file generated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Automatically, once the customer approves the final version.

mainEntity.name: What is in the production PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two pages: the approved product proof and an artwork inspection page, with placement details and the decision record.

mainEntity.name: Who is the file for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decorators and production teams, so they receive the approved artwork and placement guidance in one file.

mainEntity.name: Does it include only the approved artwork?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Only the approved version is included, so earlier revisions never reach production.

mainEntity.name: What artwork specs does it include, such as vector files, colors or decoration method?

acceptedAnswer.text: Page one lists the item, decoration, imprint size and colors, and page two is a vector artwork inspection sheet.
